localidad: Laguna #3, Complejo de Lagunas de Sevilla, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Ciénaga, Magdalena
comentarios:
Sunny and clear morning, bird land on top of a bush and start singing and flight off, the same bird was seen several times that day chasing off Santa Marta Metaltail's and Black-back thornbill's.
Recorded during a expedition with Jonathan Slifkin to photograph several Santa Marta Endemics.
